writtenBy: pi coding agent, model alias 'worker-capable' (LiteLLM provider) — a model from a different family than the later retrieval-tuning builder
note: Held-out retrieval eval cases: written before any tuning, and never used by the builder to adjust the demo answering pipeline. 'expectedSourceIds' lists the demo sources (by id from worker/demo-sources.js PUBLIC_DEMO_SOURCES) a correct source-backed answer should cite. A no-answer case expects an empty list: the demo sources do not cover the question and the rep should say so instead of citing anything.
